query: Plan a quick 1-day Cairo highlights tour.
answer:
**Day 1 — Cairo Highlights**

Morning (9:00–12:00)
• **The Egyptian Museum** — 2 hours — This is the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities, including treasures from Tutankhamun's tomb. Arrive early to avoid the crowds, and focus on the ground floor for massive royal statues before moving upstairs for intricate jewelry. Ticket price: **200 EGP**. [More info](https://egyptianmuseumcairo.eg/)  
![The Egyptian Museum](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/the-egyptian-museum-0-1781614373.jpg)

Lunch
• **Felfela Restaurant** — a great spot for traditional Egyptian cuisine like koshari and falafel, located near Tahrir Square.

Afternoon (13:00–16:00)
• **National Museum of Egyptian Civilization (NMEC)** — 1.5 hours — Explore 50,000 artifacts and the Royal Mummies Hall in a modern setting. Arrive early to visit the mummies before the tour groups swarm. Ticket price: **200 EGP**. [More info](http://www.nmec.gov.eg/)  
![NMEC](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/national-museum-of-egyptian-civilization-nmec-0-1781568424.jpg)

• **Ben Ezra Synagogue** — 1 hour — A medieval synagogue in Coptic Cairo, said to be where baby Moses was found. It's rich in history and offers a glimpse into Cairo's Jewish heritage. Entry is free, but donations are welcome.  
![Ben Ezra Synagogue](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/ben-ezra-synagogue-1-1781569653.jpg)

Evening
• **Tentmakers' Street** — Explore this vibrant street filled with hand-stitched textiles and crafts. It's perfect for souvenir shopping and experiencing local craftsmanship. Best visited in the late afternoon when the colors are vivid.  
![Tentmakers' Street](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/tentmakers-street-0-1781569400.jpg)

---

**Travel Tips**
- Wear comfortable shoes, as you'll be doing a lot of walking.
- Bring water and sunglasses, especially if you're visiting during the hotter months.
- Consider using a local guide for deeper insights, especially at the museums.
